title: Thermal decomposition of atrazine and its toxic products
content:
Environ. Sci.: Processes Impacts, 2025, Advance Article
DOI: 10.1039/D4EM00751D, Paper
Nathan H. Weber, John C. Mackie, Justin Bolam, John A. Lucas, Michael Stockenhuber, Eric M. Kennedy
At temperatures above 400 °C, the thermal decomposition of ATZ produces highly toxic chemicals including hydrogen cyanide (HCN), thus posing environmental and health risks.
